tools.name: go-decide-ask
tools.description: Ask a System One model to choose between options

backend.description: the System One model to ask: jev, clef

confident.description: confidence at or above which the outcome is decided (default 0.9, a placeholder until #6)

dry-run.description: emit the envelope without side effects

floor.description: confidence below which the outcome is escalate (default 0.5, a placeholder until #6)

idempotency-key.description: opaque key used to prevent duplicate-create retries

option.description: an option as name=description, repeated; the order is kept

spec.description: decision spec as a JSON file, or - for standard input

state.description: the content to decide on, as a string

strict.description: escalate warnings to a validation error

tools.name: go-decide-score
tools.description: Ask Jev to rate content against an ordered rubric

backend.description: the System One model to ask: jev, clef

confident.description: confidence at or above which the outcome is decided (default 0.9, a placeholder until #6)

dry-run.description: emit the envelope without side effects

floor.description: confidence below which the outcome is escalate (default 0.5, a placeholder until #6)

idempotency-key.description: opaque key used to prevent duplicate-create retries

level.description: a level as name=description, repeated, lowest first

spec.description: decision spec as a JSON file, or - for standard input

state.description: the content to decide on, as a string

strict.description: escalate warnings to a validation error

prompts.name: decide
prompts.title: Run the decide skill
prompts.description: Three-agent adversarial debate for strategic decisions, with an optional go-decide pre-screen. A clear System One answer skips the debate. Otherwise two advocates steelman opposing positions while a moderator identifies risks and writes a binding consensus. Use when choosing between alternatives, evaluating tradeoffs, or making high-stakes decisions.

arguments.name: decision
arguments.description: The decision and the options being weighed.

prompts.template:
Run the decide skill on this decision: {{decision}}

Read the MCP resource go-decide://skills/decide/SKILL.md from the go-decide server and follow it. Its references/ paths resolve against that URI.
